title: Police identify man who died in custody
article: A 34-year-old man who died while in police custody in Saskatoon early Wednesday morning has been identified as Christopher Jason Hiebert.
Police reported Friday an autopsy had been conducted but preliminary results didn't reveal anything conclusive about the cause of death.
They added that other tests, including a toxicology analysis, were being done and investigators were still waiting for those results.
No additional information was provided, including why Hiebert had been put into a police cell.
On Wednesday, police reported that the man was unresponsive when they checked on him around 11:30 p.m. Tuesday night.
Police and ambulance workers tried to revive him. He was taken to hospital but was pronounced dead shortly after midnight.
A coroner's inquest is also expected, standard procedure when a person dies in police custody.
